name: Spinach
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Have 2 pans filled with cold water
Pick over the leaves carefully and drop them into 1 pan of water
Shake them well in the water and lift them into the other pan
Empty the water from the first pan and fill it again with cold water
Wash the spinach in this way until not a grain of sand is left in it
Put the leaves in a granite kettle and cover closely
Add the salt when about half cooked
When tender, turn into a colander and chop with a knife
Put into a hot vegetable dish and add the butter

source.originalInstructions:
1. Have 2 pans filled with cold water
2. Pick over the leaves carefully and drop them into 1 pan of water
3. Shake them well in the water and lift them into the other pan
4. Empty the water from the first pan and fill it again with cold water
5. Wash the spinach in this way until not a grain of sand is left in it
6. Put the leaves in a granite kettle and cover closely
7. Cook gently for 3/4 hour
8. Add the salt when about half cooked
9. When tender, turn into a colander and chop with a knife
10. Drain well
11. Put into a hot vegetable dish and add the butter
